ThingDef.label: Whispers acoustic sensory node
ThingDef.description: A cultured neural-auditory implant reconstructed from Whispers hybrid biopsy tissue. It reproduces part of the hybrid's extreme sound-localisation network without imposing blindness or other Michael-hybrid physiology.

ThingDef.label: Whispers mist gland
ThingDef.description: A cultured neck-gill organ derived from Whispers hybrid tissue. Once implanted, it continuously emits non-toxic obscuring biological mist around the bearer in the same ten-tile radius and at the same rate as a native Whispers hybrid, without changing the bearer's species.
